user_has_pending_request_in_epoch_e.meaning: user has a pending withdrawal request in an active withdrawal epoch E

request_retrievable_via_standard_functio.meaning: the user's pending withdrawal request in epoch E remains retrievable via a standard contract function, i.e. executeWithdrawal succeeds or cancelWithdrawal succeeds

cancel_withdrawal_succeeds.meaning: the standard cancelWithdrawal function successfully cancels the user's pending withdrawal request in epoch E

assumptions: The pending withdrawal request belongs to an active withdrawal epoch E at the time of the retrieval attempt.
executeWithdrawal and cancelWithdrawal are the standard contract functions available to the user for retrieving a pending request.
limitations: The report does not give the exact epoch index or numeric share amount; these are symbolic.
The retrievability symbol is a report-grounded Boolean disjunction of the two standard retrieval paths; the report gives no numeric definition for it.
This plan formalizes only the cancellation-path impact; the executeWithdrawal path is a separate claim.
